# `fjc_courts`

**FJC native court labels**

FJC native court labels with exact retained FJC source evidence.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Each selected complete FJC Article III flat export retains its native judge population and repeated service groups, including listed historical courts and recess appointees. Acquisition time identifies an observation, not a frozen publisher revision. Other federal judges and vacancy histories are outside this export. Earlier observations survive only when selected together or retained in prior generations. Missing later rows do not prove deletion; cross-source identities remain unresolved. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `fjc_courts.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Exact admitted source-release digest; include it in every join to keep observations separate. |
| `court_label_id` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 key of the exact FJC court-type and court-name pair. A label key, not a proven cross-source court identity; join with snapshot_id. |
| `court_type_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC court type, including historical categories and Other. |
| `court_name_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal FJC court name; exact-label equality supports the in-source relationship only. |
| `external_court_id` | `VARCHAR` | NULL until a separately evidenced cross-source court mapping is supplied. |
| `external_identity_status` | `VARCHAR` | unresolved; this build performs no cross-source person or court matching. |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Positional source-record identity in the admitted release. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original URL, response SHA-256, byte size, acquisition time, CSV record number and exact byte span. Byte offsets are zero based; CSV record numbers include the header. |
